title: CJP volunteers stage flash protest at Jantar Mantar against SIR
seoTitle: Delhi CJP flash protest at Jantar Mantar

tea.why: Protesting against the special intensive revision of electoral rolls and the Centre's order denotifying Jantar Mantar as a protest site.
tea.want: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the right to protest at Jantar Mantar.
tea.changed: Oct 13: Delhi Police detained CJP leaders and volunteers following a flash protest at Jantar Mantar.

summary: On October 13, 2026, volunteers and leaders from the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) staged a flash protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi. The demonstration followed a recent Centre order denotifying Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site, and formed part of ongoing opposition and group demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar regarding the special intensive revision (SIR) controversy. Participants scaled iron gates and police barricades, raising slogans before being pursued and detained by Delhi Police personnel stationed at the location.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
response: Delhi Police personnel chased and detained the protesters at the scene, according to source reports.

updates.text: CJP leaders and volunteers staged a flash protest at Jantar Mantar after it was denotified as a protest site, leading to their detention by Delhi Police.
